providers.name: MagnusMetal
providers.description: Magnus Metal (MagnusMetal Ltd.) is an Israeli advanced-manufacturing company bringing metal casting into the Industry 4.0 era with its patent-pending Digital Casting System. Founded in 2017 and headquartered at the Revadim Industrial Park in Kibbutz Revadim, Israel, the company builds machines that combine additive-manufacturing and casting principles: a slicer designs a ceramic mold layer by layer and solid alloy is deposited into each layer, so parts are produced from widely available solid metals rather than powders and with no hard tooling. The company markets the process for powertrains, engines, industrial machinery and structural components, claiming removal of 6-18 weeks of tooling lead time, up to 70% raw-material savings and roughly 50% lower energy use. Magnus Metal is a hardware and materials manufacturer - it sells castings and casting systems, not software - and publishes no public developer program, API, SDK or machine-readable contract of any kind.

providers.name: Kilsar
providers.description: Kilsar is an AI-powered maintenance training and operations platform for the aviation, defense, and industrial sectors. Its flagship product, Orion, turns static technical manuals and maintenance procedures into intelligent, guided workflows so technicians learn faster and perform complex tasks correctly. The platform provides AI-assisted search across operational and maintenance manuals, dynamic data storage and library management, custom workflow and procedure building, real-time task tracking and work-log monitoring, and predictive maintenance and troubleshooting guidance. Kilsar promises measurable outcomes including reduced downtime, faster mean-time-to-repair, and increased equipment uptime. Kilsar is a Techstars-backed company. As of this profile it publishes a marketing site and a Secureframe-hosted trust center but no public API, developer documentation, or SDKs.

providers.name: AMSC
providers.description: American Superconductor Corporation (AMSC) is a power control systems company headquartered in Ayer, Massachusetts, and traded publicly on NASDAQ under the ticker AMSC. The company designs and delivers grid and power-electronics solutions across three specialties - power supply, power protection, and power innovation - serving the energy, renewables, utility, industrial, materials, and military sectors. Its offerings span grid capacity and resiliency systems, renewable generation integration, industrial process power control, and shipboard power protection for naval defense. AMSC is an early Battery Ventures portfolio investment. AMSC does not currently publish a public developer API, SDK, or developer portal; this profile captures the company's corporate identity and domain security posture within the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Cintas
providers.description: Cintas Corporation is a Fortune 500 provider of uniform rental, facility services, first aid and safety products, and fire protection services. Cintas does not currently publish a public developer portal; B2B integrations (ordering, EDI, route management, billing) are delivered to enterprise customers through the myCintas portal, the Cintas Partner Connect program, and account-managed EDI relationships.

providers.name: Re:Build
providers.description: Re:Build Manufacturing is a U.S.-based industrial engineering and manufacturing company that takes complex products from concept to full-rate production through integrated design, engineering, and scalable domestic manufacturing. Founded to rebuild American manufacturing capacity, the company operates a family of specialized engineering and production businesses across more than 14 U.S. locations, spanning aerospace and defense, electrification, energy and environment, medical devices, and robotics and automation. With 400+ engineers and roughly one million square feet of industrial footprint, Re:Build partners with startups and established manufacturers to develop, industrialize, and produce advanced physical products. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of General Catalyst and added to the API Evangelist network; enrichment confirms it is an industrial/manufacturing company with no public API, developer, or machine surface at this time.

providers.name: Divergent
providers.description: Divergent Technologies, Inc. is a Torrance and Long Beach, California manufacturer that built the Divergent Adaptive Production System (DAPS), an end-to-end software-hardware production system for industrial digital manufacturing. DAPS pairs AI-driven generative design software with in-house metal additive manufacturing — the Monolith One printer, compatible with aluminum, nickel, steel and titanium alloys — and automated fixtureless robotic assembly, so complex multi-part structures can be engineered, printed and assembled without fixed tooling. Founded in 2013 by Kevin and Lukas Czinger, the company is a Tier 1 supplier to global automotive OEMs and has expanded into aerospace and defense, including selection under the US Air Force Eglin Wide Agile Acquisition Contract. Divergent sells manufactured structures and production capacity, not software: it publishes no developer portal, no public API, and no machine-readable contract of any kind.

providers.name: Ryerson Holding
providers.description: Ryerson Holding Corporation is a leading value-added processor and distributor of industrial metals, with operations across the United States, Canada, Mexico, China, and Brazil. The company offers a broad range of stainless steel, aluminum, carbon steel, and alloy steels in various shapes and forms. Ryerson operates an e-commerce platform at Ryerson.com enabling online metal ordering, order status tracking, and shipment management. The company has integrated its CRM (Salesforce) with ERP (SAP) for streamlined order management and uses EDI and API-based integration for wholesale distribution operations.

providers.name: C-Infinity
providers.description: C-Infinity is a Mountain View, California company founded in 2023 that builds foundational AI for mechanical design and manufacturing — AI that reasons about geometry, motion, spatial constraints, and production logic. Its platform, AutoAssembler, connects directly to existing CAD and PLM environments to automate assembly process planning, accelerate engineering change order (ECO) reviews, and generate production-ready assembly work instructions, compressing work that historically took weeks into minutes. The product is described by the company as API-first, with an integration layer that connects upstream to engineering systems and downstream to production, but as of July 2026 C-Infinity publishes no public developer portal, API reference, SDKs, or OpenAPI definition — the AutoAssembler application is gated behind a request-a-demo flow and integration is arranged directly with the company. C-Infinity raised a $16M round in April 2026 led by Canaan Partners, with participation from Inventus Capital, Bee Partners, and Radius Capital, and reports deployments across Global Fortune 100 manufacturers as well as small and mid-sized enterprises.

providers.name: Niron Magnetics
providers.description: Niron Magnetics is a U.S. advanced-manufacturing company commercializing high-performance permanent magnets made from Iron Nitride rather than rare-earth elements. Spun out of University of Minnesota and U.S. Department of Energy ARPA-E research and founded in 2013, the company holds 150+ patents around its Clean Earth Magnet technology and is building the first full-scale Iron Nitride magnet plant in Sartell, Minnesota, alongside its Minneapolis headquarters and a Washington, D.C. policy office. Its magnets target electric-motor, automotive, consumer-audio, industrial and defense applications, with announced collaborations including Stellantis, Moog, Aspina, FaitalPRO, MATTER and Bimotal. Niron Magnetics is a materials and hardware manufacturer: it publishes no developer program, no public API, and no machine-readable API contract.

providers.name: Seurat Technologies
providers.description: Seurat Technologies is a Wilmington, Massachusetts contract manufacturer that produces high-volume metal parts using its proprietary Area Printing technology, a Laser Powderbed Fusion (LPBF) additive process that decouples print speed from resolution and is positioned as roughly 10x more productive than conventional LPBF. Seurat does not sell 3D printers; it sells parts, qualifying customer designs through its Area Printing Production (APP) qualification program and then mass-producing them at localized factories for consumer electronics, automotive, energy, aerospace and defense OEMs. The company markets its process on reshoring, supply-chain resilience, tariff resistance and decarbonization, and engages customers through a quote / upload-your-part motion rather than any developer-facing product.

providers.name: Commercial Metals Company
providers.description: Commercial Metals Company (CMC) is a Fortune 500 manufacturer, recycler, fabricator and marketer of steel and metal products — rebar, merchant and structural bar, wire rod, performance steel, construction products and ground improvement solutions — running recycling centers, mini-mills, micro-mills and fabrication plants across the United States, Europe and Asia for the construction, infrastructure, energy and manufacturing markets. CMC was an early mover on customer self-service with myCMC, a portal for inventory, pricing, online ordering, material release, document search and real-time order and delivery status, and it runs a business-to-business Systems Integration program whose own one-pager names EDI, API, CSV, XML and flat file across the Quote-To-Cash process. None of it is self-service: no developer portal, no API reference and no machine-readable contract is published on any CMC host as of September 2026 — integration is arranged through a CMC sales rep or ecommerce@cmc.com.

providers.name: Graco Inc
providers.description: Graco Inc is a major US corporation and Fortune 1000 company. The Graco Inc API provides programmatic access to its platform services, data, and integrations for enterprise customers and partners.

providers.name: Carlisle Companies
providers.description: Carlisle Companies Incorporated (NYSE: CSL) is a global diversified manufacturer of highly engineered building envelope products and solutions, serving commercial and residential construction, insulation, roofing, waterproofing, and specialty markets. Carlisle's primary operating segment is Carlisle Construction Materials (CCM), which includes brands such as Carlisle SynTec Systems, Hunter Panels, Henry Company, MB Technology, and WIP Industrial. Carlisle does not publish a public developer API; distributors and direct contractors transact through the Carlisle Customer Success Portal, and commercial trading partners integrate with Carlisle using standard X12 EDI transactions (850, 855, 856, 810) over AS2/SFTP.

providers.name: Steel Dynamics
providers.description: Steel Dynamics, Inc. is one of the largest domestic steel producers and metals recyclers in the United States, with operations spanning steel manufacturing, steel processing, and metals recycling. Founded in 1993 and headquartered in Fort Wayne, Indiana, the company operates steel mills, fabrication operations, and metals recycling facilities. Steel Dynamics is a Fortune 500 company listed on NASDAQ (STLD) and does not offer public developer APIs; data access is available through financial data providers and investor relations communications.

providers.name: Worthington Industries
providers.description: Worthington Industries was a global diversified metals manufacturing company specializing in value-added steel processing and manufactured metal products. In December 2023, the company split into two publicly traded companies: Worthington Enterprises (consumer and building products) and Worthington Steel (flat-rolled steel processing, electrical steel laminations, and tailor-welded blanks). Worthington Industries does not offer a public developer API.

providers.name: OSIsoft
providers.description: OSIsoft was the enterprise software company behind the PI System, the operational data infrastructure used across manufacturing, energy, utilities, oil and gas, and other industrial sectors to collect, historize, contextualize, and visualize high-volume real-time sensor and control-system time-series data. Its developer surface centered on the PI Web API (a RESTful interface to the PI Data Archive and Asset Framework), AF SDK, and the PI Square developer community. OSIsoft was acquired by AVEVA in 2021; all osisoft.com and docs.osisoft.com properties now redirect to AVEVA, where the product ships as the AVEVA PI System. This profile is maintained as a historical/acquired-company record in the API Evangelist network, with developer resources pointing at the live AVEVA successor pages.

providers.name: Plotlogic
providers.description: Plotlogic is a mining technology company that builds AI-driven sensing systems for real-time ore and material characterisation. Its flagship product, OreSense, scans rock in open-pit, stockpile, and underground mining operations and delivers decision-ready quantitative mineralogy in under 15 minutes, compared with more than an hour for traditional laboratory assay methods. The hardware is engineered for harsh mining environments and integrates into existing operational workflows so mines can reduce waste, improve grade control, and make faster material-routing decisions. Plotlogic is headquartered in Zillmere, Queensland, Australia, and is backed by the deep-tech venture firm DCVC. Customer access is delivered through an enterprise client platform rather than a public developer API; there is no published developer program, SDK, or API documentation at this time.

providers.name: WESCO International
providers.description: WESCO International is a Fortune 500 leading provider of business-to-business distribution, logistics services, and supply chain solutions for electrical, industrial, communications, and utility customers worldwide. WESCO serves over 150,000 customers through a network of branches and distribution centers and provides comprehensive digital integration capabilities including EDI, punchout, cXML, and API connectivity for procurement automation.

providers.name: Brunswick Corporation
providers.description: Brunswick Corporation is a global leader in marine recreation and technology, headquartered in Mettawa, Illinois (NYSE: BC). Brunswick owns over 60 brands across marine propulsion (Mercury Marine, Mercury Racing, MerCruiser, Fliteboard), boat manufacturing (Boston Whaler, Sea Ray, Bayliner, Lund, Crestliner, Harris, Lowe, heyday), and marine parts and accessories (Navico Group: B&G, C-Map, Lowrance, Simrad). The company's ACES innovation strategy centers on Autonomy/Assistance, Connectivity, Electrification, and Shared Access.

providers.name: Monolith Materials
providers.description: Monolith (legally Monolith Inc., formerly Monolith Materials) is an American chemicals and advanced-materials manufacturer headquartered in Lincoln, Nebraska and founded in 2012. It is the first company to run methane pyrolysis at commercial scale, using an electrified thermal-plasma process to split natural gas or renewable biogas into solid carbon and clean hydrogen with no direct CO2 combustion. The solid carbon is finished into carbon black for tire, rubber, plastics, battery and electronics manufacturing, and the co-produced hydrogen is used on-site or converted into anhydrous ammonia. Monolith operates a demonstration plant in Redwood City, California and its commercial Olive Creek facility in Hallam, Nebraska, which since 2023 has supplied made-in-Nebraska carbon black to Goodyear. Monolith is a physical materials producer and sells industrial product, not software: it publishes no developer program, no public API, and no machine-readable API contract of any kind.

providers.name: Belden
providers.description: Belden Inc. designs, manufactures, and markets networking, connectivity, and cable products and solutions for industrial automation, smart buildings, and broadcast markets. The company delivers end-to-end signal transmission solutions for mission-critical applications, including industrial Ethernet infrastructure, cybersecurity, and IIoT connectivity. Belden's Hirschmann brand is a leading provider of industrial network switches and management software with CLI, SNMP, and REST API interfaces for network device management.

providers.name: Textron
providers.description: Textron Inc. is a $14.8 billion Fortune 500 multi-industry company employing 34,000 people worldwide. Textron operates through five business segments: Bell (military and commercial helicopters), Textron Aviation (Cessna, Beechcraft, Hawker aircraft), Industrial (Kautex fuel systems, Textron Specialized Vehicles including E-Z-GO and Jacobsen), Textron Systems (defense and autonomous systems), and Textron Financial. As of 2026, Textron does not offer publicly documented developer APIs or integration portals.

providers.name: Universal Forest Products
providers.description: UFP Industries (formerly Universal Forest Products) is a leading global manufacturer and distributor of wood and wood-alternative products serving retail, industrial, and construction markets. UFP operates over 200 facilities globally supplying lumber, engineered wood products, packaging, and building materials. The company has integrated OnBase-based business system integration for document management and workflow automation across its supply chain operations.

providers.name: Westlake
providers.description: Westlake Corporation is a global Fortune 500 manufacturer and supplier of materials and innovative products that enhance life every day. The company produces chemical materials and building products across multiple sectors including packaging, healthcare, automotive, consumer goods, and construction. Westlake operates through two primary segments: Performance and Essential Materials (PEM) and Housing and Infrastructure Products (HIP), with net sales of approximately $11 billion annually.

providers.name: Cornerstone Building Brands
providers.description: Cornerstone Building Brands is a major US corporation and Fortune 1000 company. The Cornerstone Building Brands API provides programmatic access to its platform services, data, and integrations for enterprise customers and partners.

providers.name: Corning
providers.description: Corning Incorporated is a Fortune 500 American technology company that specializes in glass science, ceramic science, and optical physics. Founded in 1851, Corning manufactures specialty glass, ceramics, and related materials and technologies for industrial and scientific applications. Corning's businesses include Optical Communications (fiber optic cable and hardware), Display Technologies (LCD and OLED glass substrates), Specialty Materials (Gorilla Glass for mobile devices), Environmental Technologies (ceramic substrates and filters for emissions control), and Life Sciences (laboratory glassware, cell culture, and bioprocess products). Corning does not publish a public developer API.

providers.name: Isembard
providers.description: Isembard is a UK- and US-based advanced manufacturing company building a distributed network of software-powered precision factories for critical industries including aerospace, defence, space, satellites, drones, nuclear energy, and motorsport. Founded in 2024 by Alexander Fitzgerald and named after engineer Isambard Kingdom Brunel, the company runs its factories on MasonOS, a proprietary AI-powered operating system that manages quoting, scheduling, production, and quality control across its factory network. Its model reshores high-precision component manufacturing closer to home to address supply-chain vulnerabilities in the Western industrial base, scaling from prototypes to production and offering factory franchise opportunities. Isembard has raised a Series A led by Union Square Ventures and operates factories across the UK, US, France, and Germany. There is no public developer API; MasonOS is an internal software platform, so this profile captures the company's identity and web surface rather than an API.

providers.name: Electra
providers.description: Electra (legal name Electrasteel, Inc.) is a Boulder, Colorado clean-industrial company founded in 2020 that is reinventing ironmaking. Instead of smelting iron ore with fossil fuels in a blast furnace, Electra uses an electrochemical process — an acidic leach plus electrowinning driven by renewable electricity — to dissolve a broad range of iron ores, including low-grade and previously uncommercialized ores, and plate out 99% pure iron at roughly 60°C while recovering high-value co-minerals and emitting oxygen. The modular design lets units be added as building blocks for rapid scaling and lets the process follow intermittent renewable power. Electra has raised over $200M from Rio Tinto, BHP Ventures, POSCO, Breakthrough Energy Ventures, Amazon's Climate Pledge Fund, Capricorn and Lowercarbon Capital, runs a pilot plant in Boulder, and is building a demonstration plant in Colorado. It is an industrial manufacturer with no public developer program: as of this profile it publishes no API, developer portal, documentation, machine-readable specification, or /.well-known discovery surface.

providers.name: Emerson Electric
providers.description: Emerson Electric is a Fortune 500 global automation leader with more than 135 years of innovation history. Its portfolio spans automation systems, discrete automation, final control, measurement instrumentation, and test and measurement, marketed through brands such as Fisher, Rosemount, DeltaV, Micro Motion, ASCO, Bettis, PACSystems, Flexim, and NI. Emerson serves industries including power, oil and gas, chemical, life sciences, food and beverage, automotive, data centers, mining, and marine. This repository captures the public APIs, developer resources, and machine-readable artifacts associated with Emerson Electric.

providers.name: Flowserve
providers.description: Flowserve moves, controls and protects the flow of materials in the world's most critical industries through pumps, seals, valves, and flow control systems. No public developer APIs have been identified; the company offers digital services such as RedRaven IIoT monitoring through customer engagements rather than an open developer portal.

providers.name: Hexcel
providers.description: Hexcel Corporation (NYSE: HXL) is a global leader in advanced composite materials for the aerospace, defense and space, and industrial markets. Headquartered in Stamford, Connecticut and operating roughly 18 manufacturing facilities worldwide with about 5,800 employees, Hexcel produces HexTow carbon fiber, HexPly prepregs, HexWeb honeycomb, HexForce reinforcements, HexBond adhesives, HexFlow infusion resins, and HexTool tooling materials supplied into commercial aircraft, military platforms, space launch vehicles, wind energy blades, and industrial structures. Hexcel is a critical materials supplier to Boeing and Airbus and supports more than 100 defense programs; it has no public developer portal, REST APIs, SDKs, or machine-readable product catalog. Customer interaction with technical resources is PDF-based (datasheets, technology manuals, brochures), and the company's GitHub organization (github.com/Hexcel) is registered but empty.

providers.name: Stegra
providers.description: Stegra (formerly H2 Green Steel) is a Stockholm-headquartered industrial company, founded in 2020 and backed by Vargas Holding, building what it describes as Europe's first large-scale near-zero-emission steel plant in Boden, northern Sweden. The 270-hectare Boden site integrates a giga-scale electrolyzer producing green hydrogen from renewable Nordic electricity, a direct-reduction plant making green iron without coking coal, and a downstream steel mill — a combination Stegra says cuts steelmaking emissions by roughly 95 percent versus the blast-furnace route. Its commercial products are green steel, green iron and green hydrogen, sold to automotive, construction and appliance customers. Stegra is a heavy-industry manufacturer rather than a software vendor: it operates no public developer portal, publishes no API documentation, and serves no machine-readable API contract. Its only public engineering surface is the stegraab GitHub organization, which maintains community Terraform providers and a tflint ruleset used for its own internal infrastructure.

providers.name: HONESS (Shanghai Hongji Environmental Protection)
providers.description: HONESS (泓济环保 / Shanghai Hongji Environmental Protection, honess.cn) is a Chinese environmental services provider founded in 2006, specializing in industrial wastewater treatment and the broader treatment of the "three wastes" (wastewater, waste gas, and hazardous waste). It offers customized environmental solutions, environmental equipment manufacturing and integration, EPC delivery for energy and chemical full-water systems, fine-chemical waste treatment, process packages for new and upgraded wastewater plants, and technology-enabled ("smart") digital operations and maintenance. The company holds top-grade design and contracting qualifications, has delivered 500+ design/build/operation projects for 300+ clients across China and abroad, and operates manufacturing and R&D bases in Shanghai and Anhui. It is not a developer/API company; the public surface is a WordPress corporate site with no developer portal, API documentation, SDKs, or OAuth. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Qiming Venture Partners and profiled in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Spider Capital
providers.description: Spider Capital is a seed-stage venture capital firm investing in applied-AI enterprise cloud software that modernizes complex industrial sectors. The firm backs founders across construction, financial services, energy, government, healthcare, insurance, mining, manufacturing, supply chain, and transportation, citing 100+ enterprise cloud investments, a 70%+ seed-to-Series-A graduation rate, and portfolio companies including Mechanical Orchard, Imubit, CoLab, Percepto, Codoxo, Klir, Elara Spatial, and Logiwa. Surfaced as a portfolio company of foundry-group; it publishes no public API or developer surface (venture-capital firm), so this profile carries firm identity rather than API artifacts.

providers.name: CMC Materials
providers.description: CMC Materials is a global supplier of consumable materials primarily to the semiconductor industry, including chemical mechanical planarization (CMP) slurries and polishing pads. Acquired by Entegris in 2022, CMC's materials portfolio is now part of the Entegris specialty chemicals and CMP solutions business, serving semiconductor manufacturers through advanced materials and process technologies.

providers.name: I-Pulse
providers.description: I-Pulse Inc. is a U.S.-based industrial technology company founded in 2007 by Robert Friedland and Laurent Frescaline that commercializes High Pulsed Power (HPP) — releasing very short, extremely high-power electrical discharges from small amounts of stored energy to generate magnetic forces, shockwaves, electrical arcs and electric fields. I-Pulse holds 55 patents licensed exclusively to its operating businesses across natural-resource transformation (I-ROX rock comminution, I-Mine, iTerra non-chemical weed control, IPW), the energy transition (G-Pulse pulsed-power geothermal drilling, Blue Spark Geothermal), manufacturing (Bmax electromagnetic metal forming and welding, CSI Technologies high-energy capacitors) and R&D (I-Cube, Typhoon). It operates from Albuquerque, New Mexico and Toulouse, France, with offices in Canada, the UK and Singapore, and signed a $250 million CHIPS R&D award with the U.S. Department of Commerce in 2026 for semiconductor and pulsed-power development. I-Pulse is a hardware and industrial-process company; it publishes no developer program, API documentation or machine-readable API contract.

providers.name: Riiico
providers.description: RIIICO is a Duesseldorf-based industrial software company building 3D-AI tools that digitalize the factory shop floor. Its platform turns reality scans (point clouds) of existing plants into CAD-ready, pre-classified 3D models, cutting 3D modeling time by up to 80% and accelerating factory retrofit, robot programming, and simulation. RIIICO integrates with NVIDIA Omniverse (OpenUSD) and Siemens Xcelerator, and counts Siemens, Volvo, and Schaeffler among its customers. It won the Siemens Inventors of the Year Award 2024 and is backed by Earlybird, PiLabs, and seed + speed. No public API, SDK, or developer documentation surface was found during enrichment.

providers.name: Scope
providers.description: Scope (Scope Inspection Ltd, London) is an AI-native inspection platform for the Testing, Inspection, and Certification (TIC) industry and heavy-asset operators. It captures field data through voice, video, and forms (offline-capable), extracts structured data from P&IDs, ASME forms, and inspection drawings, surfaces historical inspection context, and automates report generation in Word, Excel, and PDF. The product pushes results into enterprise CMMS/EAM systems via webhooks and prebuilt connectors, but publishes no public developer API, developer portal, OpenAPI, or documentation surface at this time. Backed by Index Ventures and Y Combinator; raised a ~$18-20M round led by Index Ventures in 2026.

providers.name: Pairio
providers.description: Pairio is an AI-powered maintenance assistant for manufacturing and industrial teams, built by Pairio GmbH in Munich, Germany and backed by Y Combinator. Technicians capture voice, photos, and video on the shop floor, and Pairio troubleshoots machine breakdowns, searches technical documentation and maintenance history, identifies spare parts, generates structured maintenance reports, and creates work instructions. It preserves expert knowledge across shifts, sites, and teams to reduce mean time to repair (MTTR) and unplanned downtime, integrating with common ERP, CMMS, EAM, and document-management systems such as SAP, IFS, IBM Maximo, Oracle EAM, Hexagon, SharePoint, and Outlook. Pairio is a consumer-facing mobile/web application and does not currently publish a public developer API.

providers.name: MKS Instruments
providers.description: MKS Instruments is a global provider of foundational technology solutions for semiconductor manufacturing, electronics and packaging, and specialty industrial markets. Its product portfolio spans vacuum and gas delivery systems, photonics, lasers, optics, motion control, and process control. No public developer API or developer portal has been identified at the corporate level; technical integration is typically handled through product-level documentation, sales engineering, and partner channels.

providers.name: Eastman Chemical
providers.description: Driven by more than 100 years of continuous innovation, Eastman is a global Fortune 500 specialty materials company that produces a broad range of advanced materials, chemicals, and fibers used in everyday products. Eastman operates a customer-facing Customer Center for orders, documents, and Safety Data Sheets, but no public developer portal or REST API has been documented.

providers.name: Cameron International
providers.description: Cameron International (formerly Cooper Cameron Corporation) was a leading provider of flow equipment products, systems, and services to the worldwide oil, gas, and process industries. In 2016 the business was acquired by Schlumberger (now SLB) and its pressure-control, drilling, subsea, valves, measurement, and compression product lines were integrated into SLB's digital oilfield portfolio. Cameron-branded capabilities are now delivered and integrated through the SLB DELFI digital platform and its developer APIs rather than through a standalone Cameron developer program.

providers.name: Crown Holdings
providers.description: Crown Holdings, Inc. is a global leader in the design, manufacture, and sale of rigid packaging products for consumer goods, including metal beverage cans and ends, food cans, aerosol cans, specialty closures and promotional tins, as well as transit and protective packaging products for industrial markets. The company operates in more than 40 countries and supports customers with design, decoration, reprographics, compound development, pilot facilities, and seaming training services. Crown Holdings does not publish a public developer API program; technical collaboration with customers happens through B2B and EDI channels.

providers.name: Hertha Metals
providers.description: Hertha Metals is a hard-technology steel production company based in Conroe, Texas, working to decarbonize and modernize primary steelmaking after centuries of coke-based blast-furnace iron and steel production. Founded by Laureen Meroueh, the company has developed proprietary pyrometallurgical HERS and Flex-HERS technology that produces steel from flexible feedstocks in a single reactor, and has raised roughly $17M toward a commercial steel plant. Hertha Metals is an industrial / climate-tech manufacturer with no public API, developer portal, or programmatic surface; it is tracked in the API Evangelist network as a Khosla Ventures portfolio company profile.

providers.name: Oshkosh
providers.description: Oshkosh Corporation is a Fortune 500 industrial company that designs and builds purpose-built vehicles and vehicle bodies, including access equipment, defense vehicles, fire and emergency apparatus, refuse collection vehicles, and concrete mixers.

providers.name: Moog
providers.description: Moog Inc. is a worldwide designer, manufacturer, and integrator of precision motion and fluid control products and solutions for aerospace, defense, industrial, and medical applications. Product divisions include actuation, motion systems, motors, propulsion, valves, aerospace components, and defense systems. Moog does not currently publish a public developer API or developer portal.

providers.name: Berry Global
providers.description: Berry Global is a leading global manufacturer and marketer of plastic packaging products, nonwoven specialty materials, and engineered materials for consumer and industrial end markets. In 2024, Berry Global merged with Amcor to form one of the world's largest packaging companies. Berry's products include rigid open top packaging, closures and dispensing systems, flexible packaging, tapes, and engineered materials.

providers.name: Sortera Technologies
providers.description: Sortera Technologies (formerly Sortera Alloys) is an AI-driven metals recycling company founded in 2020 and headquartered in Markle / Fort Wayne, Indiana. It combines sensor fusion (XRF plus optical), machine-learning image and data analytics, and an advanced high-throughput scrap feeder to sort end-of-life scrap by metal type and alloy composition, upgrading feedstock streams and removing contaminants at industrial scale. From a 200,000 square foot sortation facility opened in 2023 the company produces specification aluminum scrap across cast, extrusion and sheet fractions - including 380, 356, 319 and wrought grades such as 3105 - and sells it back into domestic manufacturing. Its stated vision is 100% reuse of metals recovered from end-of-life products. The artificial intelligence runs inside Sortera's own sorting lines as an in-house platform; the product sold is recycled metal, not software, and the company publishes no public API, SDK, developer portal or machine-readable specification.

providers.name: Sunrise
providers.description: Sunrise Robotics builds intelligent, two-armed autonomous robotic cells for manufacturing. The AI-driven system combines built-in perception and environmental awareness with autonomous execution to transform existing production processes, increase capacity, and free human workers for higher-value tasks. Cells deploy quickly (needing only a three-phase outlet), are flexible across manufacturing applications, and are built to ISO 10218 / TS 15066 safety standards. The company is backed by Seedcamp and Slow Ventures.

providers.name: Sonoco Products
providers.description: Sonoco Products Company is a global leader in sustainable metal and fiber consumer and industrial packaging, operating 285 facilities across 40 countries with 23,000+ employees. Products include metal packaging (aerosol cans, steel food cans, closures), rigid paper packaging (paper containers, fiber cartridges), industrial paper packaging (tubes, cores, recycled paperboard), and industrial specialty packaging (plastic components, reels, spools). Serves food and beverage, pet care, household products, beauty, automotive, and industrial markets. A Fortune 500 company (NYSE: SON).

providers.name: WestRock
providers.description: WestRock (now Smurfit Westrock following its 2024 merger with Smurfit Kappa) is one of the world's largest paper and packaging companies. The company provides differentiated paper and packaging solutions including corrugated containers, consumer packaging, displays, and specialty packaging. WestRock serves consumer and industrial markets with an integrated supply chain connecting mills, converting operations, and customers globally.

providers.name: CHINT
providers.description: CHINT (Chint Group) is a global smart-energy and intelligent-electrical solutions provider founded in 1984 and headquartered in Wenzhou, China, with operations across more than 140 countries. Its portfolio spans low-voltage electrical equipment (IEC and UL), power transmission and distribution systems, switchgear, instruments and meters, EV charging, and clean-energy systems including solar PV and battery storage, serving power utilities, buildings, telecom and data centers, industrial, and OEM sectors. CHINT does not currently publish a public developer API, OpenAPI definition, or developer portal; this profile captures the company identity and its public web properties. Added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of Hongshan (HongShan / former Sequoia China).

providers.name: Andustry
providers.description: Andustry is an AI-native industrial equipment broker that streamlines sourcing and procurement for manufacturers. The platform combines AI-powered supplier discovery with manual qualification and commercial negotiation to source industrial machines (CNC mills, lathes, press brakes, laser cutters, robotic cells), machined/forged/cast parts, and robotics and electronics across Europe, China, India, and the United States. Clients hand off a sourcing need and Andustry returns a verified supplier shortlist within 24-48 hours, delivering an average of roughly 30% cost savings and 2x faster sourcing timelines on a commission-only basis with no subscription. Founded in 2026 (Y Combinator Spring 2026 batch) by Het Dave and Johann Stuerken and operated as Andustry GmbH.

providers.name: Domtar
providers.description: Domtar is committed to turning responsibly sourced wood fiber into essential products like paper, pulp, recycled packaging, tissue, and lumber. No public developer-facing APIs have been identified at this time; this index will be updated if any are made available.

providers.name: Lincoln Electric Holdings
providers.description: Lincoln Electric Holdings is a global manufacturer of arc welding products, robotic welding systems, plasma and oxyfuel cutting equipment, and brazing and soldering alloys. The company also offers connected welding solutions and equipment monitoring software for industrial environments.

providers.name: Hydroleap
providers.description: Hydroleap is a Singapore-based greentech company revolutionizing industrial water and wastewater treatment through proprietary electrochemical technology. Its chemical-free, modularized systems - electro-coagulation (HL-EC), electro-oxidation (HL-EO), and electro-oxidation for cooling towers (HL-EO-CT) - replace conventional chemical-intensive processes with automated, energy-efficient alternatives. Hydroleap serves data centers, palm oil mills, food and beverage production, pharmaceuticals manufacturing, and municipal wastewater operators, helping businesses cut operating costs, improve regulatory compliance, and reduce environmental impact. Backed by 500 Global, the company is profiled in the API Evangelist network; it publishes a product and marketing website but no public API or developer platform.

providers.name: LiquidLight
providers.description: LiquidLight, Inc. (Liquid Light) was an electrochemistry company based in Monmouth Junction, New Jersey that developed and licensed process technology for converting carbon dioxide into industrial chemicals. Founded in 2009 by Kyle Teamey, Emily Cole, Andrew Bocarsly, Fouad Elnaggar and Nety Krishna around technology licensed from Princeton University, the company built a portfolio of more than 100 patents covering the electrochemical production of chemicals including monoethylene glycol (MEG), propylene and acetic acid, with MEG as its lead target market. It raised seed funding from Redpoint Ventures and a $15 million Series B in September 2014 from investors including VantagePoint Capital Partners and BP Ventures, and was also a Battery Ventures portfolio investment. Avantium acquired Liquid Light on January 10, 2017 and the company ceased operating independently. LiquidLight was a materials and process-technology company: it never published a public API, developer portal, SDKs or any machine-readable developer surface, and no company web property survives the acquisition. This profile is retained in the API Evangelist network as an accurate, non-API portfolio record.

providers.name: RecommerceX
providers.description: RecommerceX is an engineering-driven manufacturing company applying circular-economy practices to transform industrial waste into advanced engineering materials. It operates three flagship brands: RexSteel (seamless and ERW stainless steel pipes, tubes, forgings, flanges and heat-exchanger tubes), RexPol (HDPE and DWC polymer pipes, polymer compounds and engineering plastics), and RexTherm (critical infrastructure including liquid cooling, heat exchangers, power components and acoustics). It serves oil & gas, chemical, pharmaceutical, infrastructure, automotive, water, power and industrial manufacturing sectors. Surfaced as a portfolio company of accel and added to the API Evangelist network; the public site publishes no API, SDK, developer portal, or documentation surface.

providers.name: Seppure
providers.description: SepPure Technologies (Seppure) is a deep-tech company building advanced organic solvent nanofiltration (OSN) membrane systems that make industrial chemical separation dramatically more sustainable, claiming processes up to 580x less energy intensive than conventional thermal separation. Its product line includes GreenMem organic solvent nanofiltration membranes, RE(SOLV) solvent recovery systems, and DE(SOLV) oil-refinery equipment, serving edible-oil refining, pharmaceutical filtration, semiconductor processing, and specialty chemicals across offices in Singapore and Calgary, Canada. It is a 500 Global portfolio company. Seppure sells membranes online at seppure.shop and publishes no public API, developer documentation, or GitHub organization at this time.

providers.name: Avery Dennison
providers.description: Avery Dennison is a global materials science and manufacturing company specializing in the design and manufacture of labeling and functional materials, packaging, and intelligent labels.

providers.name: Kaiser Aluminum
providers.description: Kaiser Aluminum manufactures semi-fabricated aluminum products for industrial applications across aerospace, packaging, general engineering, and automotive markets. The nearly century-old company delivers highly engineered aluminum products focused on strength, weight efficiency, and sustainability. Kaiser Online serves as a customer portal for quotes, order tracking, depot stock searches, and material certifications.

providers.name: Archimetis
providers.description: Archimetis builds an AI-powered Operational Reasoning System for refineries, chemicals, and heavy process industries. The platform unifies data from disparate operational sources — plant historians, linear programs, advanced process control models, and digital engineering documents — into a single intelligence layer, then continuously monitors operations, performs complex engineering analysis, and applies industry best practices to surface actionable insights for operators and engineers. Marketed as "See more. Solve smarter," it targets margin improvement, cost savings, and process safety across refining, chemicals, and other heavy industries. Founded in 2023, the company raised $11.5M led by Inspired Capital. Archimetis is an enterprise B2B platform engaged through guided working sessions and demos; it does not currently publish a public API, developer portal, or SDKs.

providers.name: Conundrum
providers.description: Conundrum (Conundrum Industrial Ltd, Cambridge, UK) is an industrial AI company building AI-driven, closed-loop advanced process control (APC) and model predictive control (MPC) software for the metals, mining, and cement industries. Its platform combines physics-informed and machine-learning models with real-time controllers, optimizers, data-quality tooling, interactive process-flow diagrams, drag-and-drop dashboards, and a Python SDK for building configurable runtime applications. Conundrum optimizes crushing, grinding, flotation, and cement processes to raise throughput and metal recovery while reducing energy consumption, deployed on-premises or in the cloud across plants running 24/7. The company is backed by Speedinvest and reports deployments across multiple plants in several countries.

providers.name: ConXtech
providers.description: ConXtech is a Pleasanton, California structural steel subcontractor that designs, fabricates, delivers and erects prefabricated steel building frames for commercial construction. Its ConX Systems product line — the XL-400 and XR-200 chassis — uses patented collar-and-column connection technology and AISC 358 seismic prequalification to erect frames the company reports are three to five times faster than traditional steel erection, across healthcare, data center, retail, office, education, high-density residential, hospitality, industrial and government projects totalling more than 20 million square feet. ConXtech is a private company; its equity trades on secondary markets. It sells a physical building system, not software, and publishes no public developer program, API or machine-readable contract.

providers.name: Northvolt
providers.description: Northvolt AB is a Swedish lithium-ion battery developer and manufacturer, founded in Stockholm in 2016, that built and operated the Northvolt Ett gigafactory in Skelleftea and the Northvolt Labs R&D and qualification campus in Vasteras, with further sites in Heide (Germany), Gdansk (Poland) and Montreal (Canada). Its product line covered lithium-ion, sodium-ion and lithium-metal cells, the Voltpack Core and Voltpack Mobile System battery energy storage systems, the Revolt battery recycling operation, and a Connected Battery telemetry and fleet-management service. Northvolt AB filed for bankruptcy in Sweden on 12 March 2025; through 2025 its remaining assets in Sweden, Germany and Poland were acquired by Lyten. The company never published a public developer program, API reference or machine-readable API contract; its only named developer-facing surface, api.northvolt.com, no longer has a reachable origin.

providers.name: Owens-Illinois (O-I Glass)
providers.description: Owens-Illinois (now O-I Glass) is one of the world's leading manufacturers of glass containers, supplying glass packaging to the food, beverage, beer, wine, spirits, and pharmaceutical industries. No public APIs or developer portal have been identified at this time.

providers.name: Vanti Analytics
providers.description: Vanti Analytics was an Israeli adaptive-AI-for-manufacturing company backed by Insight Partners, offering AI-based defect detection, early fault prediction, predictive quality, and process tuning across production lines via a hosted application (app.vanti-analytics.com). The company published no public API, OpenAPI spec, SDKs, or developer program, and as of 2026-07-21 it has no live web presence - vanti-analytics.com has lapsed and is parked by a third party, vanti.ai is for sale, and the former app/support/docs subdomains no longer resolve.

providers.name: Fabrion
providers.description: Fabrion builds an AI Operating System for industrial manufacturers, applying artificial intelligence to manufacturing operations and the industrial sector. The company is a venture-backed portfolio company of 8vc and is tracked in the API Evangelist network as a company profile. As of this enrichment pass Fabrion publishes a marketing website with AI Lab, Careers, and Contact pages, but exposes no public API, developer portal, documentation, SDKs, packages, MCP server, or other machine-readable developer artifacts. providers.name: Aleris
providers.description: Aleris was a global producer of rolled aluminum products serving the aerospace, automotive, building and construction, and other industrial end-use markets. (a subsidiary of Hindalco Industries) on April 14, 2020 for approximately $2.8 billion. The company's primary product lines included aluminum sheet, plate, and engineered products for demanding applications such as aerospace structures and automotive body panels. As a manufacturing-focused business, Aleris did not maintain a public developer API program, but engaged in B2B EDI integrations with major customers and suppliers across its supply chain. The Aleris brand has since been absorbed into Novelis and aleris.com no longer serves a website.

providers.name: Aris Machina
providers.description: Aris Machina builds AI-powered industrial software for advanced manufacturing, describing its mission as delivering "industrial superintelligence" that unifies design, production, and operations through AI agents and a shared semantic knowledge model. Its products include Protos, an AI co-engineer for R&D teams that accelerates design validation and simulation; Gemba, shopfloor operational agents that provide real-time equipment diagnostics; and the Ontology Toolkit, a knowledge-integration layer that bridges data across MES, ERP, and PLM systems. Aris Machina serves batteries, biopharma, robotics, defense, and aerospace, and is backed by Earlybird. The company operates from Stockholm, Bangalore, and California. This profile was surfaced as an Earlybird portfolio company and enriched from public web sources; Aris Machina does not currently publish a public developer API surface, OpenAPI specification, or SDKs.

providers.name: Leggett and Platt

MasterBrand does not currently publish a public developer API or documentation portal.

providers.name: Grainger
providers.description: W.W. Grainger, Inc. is a Fortune 500 industrial supply company headquartered in Lake Forest, Illinois. providers.name: Graphic Packaging
providers.description: Graphic Packaging International is a Fortune 500 global manufacturer of sustainable, paperboard-based consumer packaging. Markets served include food, beverage, foodservice, household, personal care, healthcare, pharmaceuticals, pet care, beauty, and e-commerce. No public developer APIs are documented at this time.

providers.name: Huntsman Corporation
providers.description: Huntsman Corporation is a publicly traded global chemical manufacturer of differentiated and specialty chemicals serving a diverse range of consumer and industrial end markets, with operating segments in polyurethanes, performance products, and advanced materials. providers.name: Martin Marietta Materials

providers.name: Packaging Corporation of America
providers.description: Packaging Corporation of America (PCA) is the third largest producer of containerboard and corrugated packaging products in the United States, supplying packaging to food, beverage, and industrial customers. No public APIs have been documented at this time.

providers.name: Hyster-Yale Materials Handling
providers.description: Hyster-Yale Materials Handling is a global designer, engineer, manufacturer, seller, and servicer of a comprehensive line of forklifts and aftermarket parts marketed under the Hyster and Yale brands. This repository tracks public APIs, developer resources, and integration touchpoints associated with Hyster-Yale.

providers.name: LyondellBasell
providers.description: LyondellBasell Industries N.V. (NYSE: LYB) is one of the world's largest producers of polymers and plastic resins, including polyethylene, polypropylene, and specialty polyolefins such as Catalloy and Polybutene-1. The company also produces chemicals, fuels, polyolefin process technology, and advanced polymer solutions, and operates a Circular & Low Carbon Solutions (CLCS) business marketing CirculenRecover and CirculenRenew recycled and renewable polymers. LyondellBasell has no public developer program, no API documentation, and no source code published in its (empty) GitHub organization. providers.name: Owens Corning
providers.description: Owens Corning is a global Fortune 500 building and industrial materials leader committed to building a sustainable future through material innovation, providing roofing, insulation, composite materials, and doors. No public APIs or developer portal have been identified at this time.

providers.name: Berry Plastics Group
providers.description: Berry Plastics Group was a manufacturer and marketer of plastic packaging products, nonwoven specialty materials, and engineered materials serving customers across consumer and industrial markets. The company was renamed Berry Global Group in 2017 to reflect its global operations and diversified product portfolio beyond plastics. As Berry Global, the company subsequently merged with Amcor in 2024.

providers.name: Drishti
providers.description: Drishti was an AI and computer-vision company that turned manual assembly-line activity into continuous streams of process data for discrete manufacturers. Cameras securely streamed factory-floor video into proprietary neural networks that generated cycle-time data and detected the sequence of human actions within each cycle, giving plant teams system-wide visibility into variability, bottlenecks, and improvement opportunities. Founded in 2017 in Mountain View, California and backed by Emergence Capital, Drishti counted Ford, Honeywell, and Nissan among its customers before being acquired by Apple in September 2023. The company operated no public developer API, and all of its web and developer domains are now offline.

providers.name: Enviri (formerly Harsco)
providers.description: Enviri Corporation, formerly known as Harsco Corporation, is a trusted global leader in environmental solutions, developing and refining methods of recycling and beneficial reuse for industrial customers. Enviri operates through three divisions: Clean Earth (hazardous waste management and recycling), Harsco Environmental (services to the global steel industry), and Harsco Rail (rail-track maintenance equipment and services). Enviri does not currently publish a public developer portal or open APIs.

providers.name: Exide Technologies
providers.description: Exide Technologies is a global producer and recycler of lead-acid batteries used in transportation and industrial applications, serving automotive, motive power, network power, and other markets. Headquartered in Milton, Georgia, the company operates manufacturing and recycling facilities worldwide. No public developer APIs have been identified; ordering and product data are provided through B2B portals and distributor channels.

providers.name: Fastenal
providers.description: Fastenal is a leading distributor of industrial and construction supplies, offering fasteners, tools, safety equipment, and other industrial products through stores, vending, and e-commerce. While Fastenal provides EDI integrations and supply chain programs like FAST 360, FASTBin, and FASTStock to enterprise customers, no publicly documented API specifications are available.

providers.name: General Cable
providers.description: General Cable Corporation was a global developer and manufacturer of copper, aluminum, and fiber optic wire and cable products. The company was acquired by Prysmian Group in 2018 and integrated into the Prysmian portfolio. No public developer APIs are documented for General Cable.

providers.name: Ghost Robotics
providers.description: Ghost Robotics designs and manufactures quadrupedal unmanned ground vehicles (Q-UGV), with its flagship Vision 60 platform deployed across defense, public safety, law enforcement, industrial, construction, and education customers. The platform supports modular payloads for sensing, comms, and manipulation. Ghost Robotics provides a developer SDK only to vetted partners and integrators and does not operate a public developer portal, open API, or public GitHub organization.

providers.name: Greif
providers.description: Greif is an industrial packaging products and services leader with a vision to be the best performing customer service company in the world. Greif also offers digital tools such as the Greif Green Tool carbon footprint calculator and the Greif+ online platform for customers.

providers.name: Illinois Tool Works
providers.description: Illinois Tool Works (ITW) is a Fortune 500 global multi-industrial manufacturer of value-added consumables and specialty equipment with related service businesses across automotive OEM, food equipment, test and measurement, electronics, welding, polymers and fluids, construction products, and specialty products. ITW does not publish a public API or developer program. This repository exists to track APIs, SDKs, and developer resources should they become available.

providers.name: International Paper
providers.description: International Paper is a Fortune 500 producer of fiber-based packaging, pulp, and paper products serving customers in more than 150 countries. The company does not currently publish a public developer API program; business integrations are handled through customer and supplier portals.

providers.name: Jjgmachining
providers.description: JJG (JJG Aero Pvt Ltd, JJG Machining Pvt Ltd, and JJG Special Processing Pvt Ltd) is a precision contract-manufacturing group founded in 2004 that produces machined components for the aerospace, automotive, and industrial sectors. It offers 2-5 axis CNC machining alongside high-volume turned and turn-mill parts in ferrous, aluminum, copper alloys, and titanium, backed by 30+ NADCAP-approved special processes such as electroplating, anodizing, paint, and NDT. This is a physical manufacturing company with no public API, developer program, or machine-readable API artifacts; the profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network as a company record only.

providers.description: Kennametal is a leading provider of productivity solutions for metalworking, earth cutting, and wear components, coatings, and powders. providers.description: Kubota Corporation is a Japanese multinational manufacturing agricultural, construction, and industrial machinery, including compact tractors, excavators, mowers, utility vehicles, engines, and water and environmental infrastructure systems sold in over 120 countries. providers.name: Masco Corporation
providers.description: Masco Corporation is a global leader in the design, manufacture, and distribution of branded home improvement and building products, including faucets, plumbing fixtures, cabinets, paints, and architectural coatings under brands such as Delta, Behr, Hansgrohe, KILZ, and Liberty Hardware.

providers.name: Metaldyne Performance Group
providers.description: Metaldyne Performance Group was a leading provider of components for use in powertrain and safety-critical platforms for the global light, commercial, and industrial vehicle markets before being acquired by American Axle.

providers.name: Newmark Group
providers.description: Newmark Group, Inc. (NASDAQ: NMRK) is a global commercial real estate advisory and services firm headquartered in New York City. Founded in 1929 and acquired by BGC Partners in October 2011, Newmark provides capital markets, leasing, valuation & advisory, global corporate services (GCS), property management, industrial and logistics, multifamily, and retail services. The firm expanded its international footprint with the 2023 acquisition of UK-based Gerald Eve and its multifamily platform via Open Realty Advisors. Newmark publishes recurring industry research under the MarketBeat / market-report brand but does not operate a public developer program or expose machine-readable APIs.

providers.name: Pall Corporation
providers.description: Pall Corporation is a filtration, separation, and purification solutions provider serving aerospace and defense, food and beverage, semiconductors, oil and gas, and industrial manufacturing industries. Pall does not currently publish a public developer platform or REST API.

providers.name: Precision Castparts
providers.description: Precision Castparts Corp. is a worldwide manufacturer of complex metal components and products including investment castings, forgings, and fasteners and structurals for aerospace and industrial gas turbine markets. The company is owned by Berkshire Hathaway.

providers.name: prmeasure
providers.description: prmeasure (Precision Measurement & Control, 精实测控) is a Zhuhai, China based high-tech enterprise specializing in measurement, control, and artificial intelligence technologies for flexible manufacturing. The company builds industrial-grade testing and control equipment for the consumer electronics, automotive, and home-appliance industries, and offers consumer-level customized production through a C2M (customer-to-manufacturer) model. Its WowNow platform (iwownow.com) provides creative prototyping tools and flexible manufacturing equipment for individuals. prmeasure was surfaced as a portfolio company of the Qiming Venture Partners investment graph and added to the API Evangelist network. providers.name: Process Sensing Technologies
providers.description: Process Sensing Technologies (PST) is a measurement instrumentation group that designs and manufactures precision sensors and analyzers for moisture, humidity, dew point, oxygen, and trace gas measurement across industrial, pharmaceutical, food, and life-science applications. Its brand portfolio includes Michell Instruments, Rotronic, Analytical Industries, Ntron, SensoScientific, and Isensix, spanning process gas analysis and real-time environmental monitoring. The company now operates under the DwyerOmega brand following its combination with Dwyer Instruments. providers.name: Rise Robotics
providers.description: RISE Robotics develops industrial linear-actuation technology designed to replace traditional hydraulic systems. Its flagship Beltdraulic Cylinder is a fluid-free hydraulic alternative delivering faster actuation, higher reliability, no fire hazard, and fuel-source flexibility for large-scale industrial applications. The company builds actuation products (Beltdraulic Cylinder, Railgate, SuperJammer, CLD) for Tier 1 suppliers, OEMs, and the US Department of Defense. RISE Robotics is a hardware and heavy-equipment company backed by Techstars; it publishes no developer API, SDK, or developer portal, so this API Evangelist profile captures identity and domain-security posture only.

providers.name: Simplex
providers.description: Simplex (سيمبلكس) is an Egyptian industrial company representing local manufacturing and contributing to industrial development across Egypt, the Middle East, and Africa. This profile was surfaced as a stub via VC-portfolio scraping and has no API surface to enrich.

providers.name: Solugen
providers.description: Solugen is a chemical manufacturing company that produces sustainable industrial chemicals through its proprietary Bioforge platform, which combines engineered enzymes, metal catalysis, and modular process design to convert renewable feedstocks into products with minimal waste. Solugen serves markets including oil and gas, renewable fuels, aerospace and defense, water treatment, cleaning, agriculture, concrete, and personal care. Backed by Founders Fund, the company was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio lead; as of this enrichment pass Solugen publishes no public API, developer portal, SDK, or machine-readable developer surface.

providers.name: Systemax
providers.description: Systemax Inc. (now operating as Global Industrial Company, NYSE: SYX) is a B2B direct marketer of industrial, maintenance, repair, and operations (MRO) products in North America. The company sells storage and shelving, material handling equipment, safety products, tools, HVAC, office supplies, and thousands of other industrial products to businesses, educational organizations, and government entities through its Global Industrial brand. Systemax was founded in 1949 and rebranded its primary segment to Global Industrial in 2021.

providers.name: Trinity Industries
providers.description: Trinity Industries, Inc. is a leading manufacturer and lessor of railcars in North America, providing products and services to the industrial, energy, transportation, and construction sectors. The company designs, manufactures, leases, and manages railcars used to transport commodities such as energy products, agricultural goods, construction materials, and consumer staples. Trinity operates a lease fleet of over 140,000 owned and managed railcars through its TrinityRail division.

providers.name: Zwitterco
providers.description: ZwitterCo is an advanced water treatment company that manufactures filtration membranes based on zwitterionic chemistry, a surface science that makes membranes attract water rather than organic compounds and thereby resist the organic fouling that limits conventional membranes. Its product families target food and dairy processing (Evolution membranes for whey and milk concentration), industrial and municipal wastewater (Elevation membranes for landfill leachate, refinery streams, and produced water), and extreme high-fouling waste streams (Expedition superfiltration). ZwitterCo is a DCVC portfolio company. It sells physical membrane hardware and treatment systems through direct sales and does not currently publish any public developer portal, API, SDKs, or machine-readable interface; this profile is a company record in the API Evangelist network rather than an API producer.

providers.name: Hillenbrand
providers.description: Hillenbrand is a global manufacturer of highly engineered, mission-critical processing equipment and systems serving the plastics, food, and recycling industries. The company operates across more than 60 global locations with a portfolio of leading industrial brands. Hillenbrand reports approximately $2.7 billion in annual revenue and employs over 8,000 associates worldwide.

providers.name: Sylvamo
providers.description: Sylvamo is a global producer of uncoated freesheet paper, pulp, and other forest products, with mills and operations across North America, Latin America, and Europe. The company is recognized for brands such as HP Papers, Hammermill, and Chamex. No public developer API or developer portal has been identified; Sylvamo operates primarily through B2B sales channels and investor and corporate communications channels.

providers.name: Fortive
providers.description: Fortive Corporation is a Fortune 500 diversified industrial technology conglomerate headquartered in Everett, Washington. The company operates across two main segments, Advanced Healthcare Solutions and Intelligent Operating Solutions, providing essential technologies for medical device safety, radiation protection, workflow automation, hazard detection, and predictive maintenance through its operating companies. This repository captures any APIs, developer tools, and machine-readable API artifacts associated with Fortive at the parent company level. Most APIs and developer resources are maintained by Fortive's individual operating companies.

providers.name: Genuine Parts Company
providers.description: Genuine Parts Company is a Fortune 500 service organization engaged in the distribution of automotive replacement parts (the parent of NAPA Auto Parts), industrial replacement parts, and electrical materials and electronic components.

providers.name: Inxeption
providers.description: Inxeption was a B2B "industrial commerce" software company founded in 2017 by serial entrepreneur Farzad Dibachi and headquartered in Silicon Valley (San Jose / Cupertino, California). It sold a cloud commerce platform that let manufacturers, distributors and wholesalers stand up a branded online storefront and digital product catalog, then manage quoting, contract-specific pricing, purchase orders, bulk and multimodal orders, freight and logistics, returns, payments and sales analytics from one place — a category it marketed as the "Industrial Commerce SuperApp". Its best-known product was Inxeption Zippy, launched in March 2019 with UPS after an equity investment from the UPS Strategic Enterprise Fund, which bundled UPS as the shipper of choice into the storefront. The company raised roughly $186M across its rounds, including a $125M Series E in January 2022. Inxeption shut down on 2024-08-15. It never operated a public developer program: no developer portal, API reference, OpenAPI/AsyncAPI/GraphQL contract, SDK or package was ever published, and its integration story was bespoke customer and EDI connections delivered under contract. Today only the apex domain resolves, and it no longer belongs to the company — it is listed for sale on the serp.domains domain marketplace. This profile is retained as a historical company record.

providers.name: Nexa3D
providers.description: Nexa3D was a Ventura, California additive-manufacturing company that built ultrafast photopolymer 3D printers (NXE 400, XiP, XiP Pro) around its Lubricant Sublayer Photo-curing (LSPc) process, QLS selective-laser-sintering systems, and the NexaX print-preparation and print-management software. The company disclosed severe funding challenges in late 2024, withdrew from Formnext, scaled back operations, and in July 2025 sold select assets — intellectual property, inventory and equipment, but not personnel — to Stratasys, with customer support and materials continuity moving to Stratasys subsidiary iSQUARED. Nexa3D no longer operates as an independent company: nexa3d.com now 301-redirects to a third-party additive-manufacturing materials marketplace, and no public developer portal, API reference, or machine-readable specification (OpenAPI, AsyncAPI, GraphQL SDL, MCP manifest, agent card) was found on any Nexa3D host, live or archived.

providers.name: Rizm
providers.description: RIZM is a holistic energy optimization platform for industrial enterprises, operated by Kerith GmbH of Münster, Germany. It integrates data from production, energy procurement, and infrastructure into a digital twin, then optimizes energy system design and day-to-day operational decisions — from long-term infrastructure investment and power purchase agreements to short-term asset dispatch and production scheduling — helping manufacturers cut energy costs and emissions at the same time. Named customers include BMW Group, Bosch, Mercedes-Benz, Volkswagen, and BSH. The product is delivered as a login-gated web application (app.rizm.de) with authenticated documentation; no public developer API, OpenAPI, or SDK surface is published at this time. Backed by Point Nine, this profile was surfaced from the venture portfolio graph.

providers.name: General Electric
providers.description: General Electric Company has reorganized into separate publicly traded companies: GE Aerospace, focused on jet engines and aviation systems, and GE Vernova, focused on energy and power generation. GE HealthCare was spun off in 2023. No unified public developer API portal is currently published by GE Aerospace or GE Vernova.

providers.name: Utility Global
providers.description: Utility Global is a Houston, Texas industrial decarbonization company founded in 2018. Its proprietary H2Gen and eXERO platform converts water into high-purity hydrogen using the residual electrochemical energy already present in industrial off-gases and biogenic gases — driving water electrolysis without electricity — while concentrating CO2 into a separate capture-ready stream. The company sells into steel, low-carbon fuels, and refining, petrochemicals and chemicals, and has run demonstration programs on blast-furnace off-gas at commercial steel facilities. It is a hardware and process-technology business, not a software vendor: its public web presence is a marketing site with no developer program, no API documentation, and no machine-readable contract of any kind.

providers.name: Atkore

Its PitchPro 2000 is a complete pitch-system replacement for aging GE 1.5 wind turbines, pairing the HET motor with KEBA drive electronics, a Bachmann PLC controller, and ultracapacitor backup power. providers.name: Fulcrum BioEnergy
providers.description: Fulcrum BioEnergy, Inc. was a Pleasanton, California waste-to-fuels project developer founded in 2007 that converted municipal solid waste into synthetic crude oil for refining into sustainable aviation fuel (SAF) and diesel, using a shred-and-sort feedstock line feeding a gasifier and a Fischer-Tropsch conversion train. Its first and only commercial plant, the Sierra BioFuels Plant in the Tahoe Reno Industrial Center outside Reno, Nevada, was designed to take roughly 175,000-219,000 tons of household garbage a year from an adjacent feedstock processing facility and began production in late 2022. The company raised on the order of a billion dollars in equity, debt and government support over its life, including strategic investments and offtake alliances with United Airlines, Waste Management, Cathay Pacific Airways, Marubeni and bp, plus a US Department of Energy loan guarantee, USDA loan guarantee and Department of Defense grants; E. James Macias led it as president and CEO through its build-out years, and it had announced follow-on projects including a Gary, Indiana plant and the NorthPoint facility in the UK. The Sierra plant stopped operating in mid-May 2024 after persistent equipment problems, the company laid off essentially its entire workforce and took its website down, and on 2024-09-09 Fulcrum BioEnergy, Fulcrum Sierra Holdings and Fulcrum Sierra Finance Co. filed voluntary Chapter 11 petitions in the US Bankruptcy Court for the District of Delaware listing more than $456 million owed to over 200 creditors. A November 2024 auction sold the biorefinery to Switch, Ltd. for $55 million and the adjacent feedstock processing facility to Refuse Inc., a WM subsidiary; the plan of liquidation was confirmed in April 2025 and went effective in May 2025. Fulcrum was an industrial energy project developer rather than a software company and never published a developer program, public API, SDK, webhook surface, or machine-readable specification — a Wayback index of its corporate site from 2008 through 2024 turns up no developer, reference, or spec path of any kind. Its corporate host fulcrum-bioenergy.com no longer resolves to any web server, and the alternate registration fulcrumbioenergy.com is parked on the GoDaddy/Afternic aftermarket and listed for sale. This profile is retained as a historical record; there is no API surface to enrich.
